## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe how this feature would be used and who would benefit from it.

## Plugin Potential

Could this feature be implemented as a plugin? (See [Plugin Architecture](https://github.com/tipchain/tipchain#-plugin-system))

- [ ] Yes, this could be a plugin
- [ ] No, this requires core changes
- [ ] Not sure

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.
